description: Move an order between statuses: new→draft, draft→reserved (reserves the items and assigns an order number), stopped→archived, or back to an earlier status with revert: true. Canceling is deliberately NOT offered (Booqable cannot un-cancel). started/stopped are reached by picking up/returning items, so they are only valid here with revert: true. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_status_transitions.

confirm_shortage.description: true to accept a shortage warning when reserving.

revert.description: true when going back to an earlier status (required for started/stopped).

transition_from.description: The order's CURRENT status (Booqable checks it).

name: booqable_transition_order_status
title: Change an order's status
